<thought>From the 13C NMR data, the peaks in the aromatic region (≈120‑150 ppm) are at 134.30, 131.90, 128.20 (appearing twice), and 127.40 (appearing twice). Counting each distinct carbon gives 6 aromatic carbons. The remaining peak at 168.20 ppm is a carbonyl carbon, not aromatic.</thought>
<final_answer>6</final_answer>
